text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malawi experienced a two-hour long countrywide power blackout on Monday night after an oil circuit breaker exploded at the hydro power station, said Electricity Supply Commission of Malawi sources.
- The High Court in Blantyre on Monday granted an injunction restraining the Electoral Commission from conducting by-elections at Machinga, more than 100km north east of Blantyre.
- Junior Police officers have set December 24 as the date for their nationwide strike, a shift from December 17.
- The High Court in Blantyre yesterday slapped an injunction on the Electoral Commission restraining it from holding the Machinga by-elections scheduled for Tuesday November 19.
